must_identify.item: New api pods are stuck in Init:0/1 because the init container wait-for-db never completes
must_identify.evidence: The new ReplicaSet `api-77b4b6956f` produced a single pod (`api-77b4b6956f-7n2df`) that remained stuck in `Init:0/1` status from the moment of creation, never reaching Ready [5, 6, 7]. ... Because the init container never exits, the main `api` container in every new pod remains in `PodInitializing`, preventing the rollout from ever completing

must_identify.item: It waits for postgres:5432, and no Service named postgres exists in namespace shop
must_identify.evidence: added an init container named `wait-for-db`, which loops indefinitely running `nc -z -w2 postgres 5432` until a Postgres endpoint responds [7]. No Postgres Service or Pod exists anywhere in the cluster — only `kubernetes`, `kube-dns`, `metrics-server`, and the `shop` namespace's `api`, `frontend`, and `redis` services are present [9, 14] — so this init container can never succeed.

notes: The fix is only implied ("until the bad init container is removed"). The RCA does note that the api does not use postgres. It misstates the alert severity as high (the alert is warning). Its claim of an out-of-band edit, based on the last-applied-configuration annotation, is speculative and was not verified.
